messages:
maria_docs: Heads-up — we're going to deprecate the old tracehook v1 snippets in console examples next week. Need to coordinate PRs, redirect links, and publish a migration note. :wave:

alex_m: Ok noted. Which snippets exactly? the Python/Node/Rust ones under /examples/console/tracehook/?

maria_docs: Yes, and the small dashboard YAML that references tracekey v1. Also any SDK snippets that call `set_trace_context` (old API). I found three docs pages with inline code that will break if we remove v1.

dennis_eng: Fingers on me for the Node example migration. I'll prepare a backwards-compatible shim and a replacement snippet. Planning to open a PR by EOD.

lina_sre: I can run a quick smoke test against staging Dedicated to validate the shim under load. Share the snippet PR and I'll add a quick perf run.

maria_docs: Thanks. Action plan suggestion: 1) create migration PRs that (a) add new snippet, (b) keep v1 snippet with a deprecation note for 2 weeks, (c) add redirect link and update anchors; 2) update Console examples index to point to new snippet; 3) sweep internal links via linkcheck.

alex_m: I'll do the linkcheck sweep. Which search pattern do we use? I can run the script: `scripts/link_audit.sh --path docs/console --match \"tracehook\"` and post results.

maria_docs: Perfect. Also add a small migration note block under each page: a one-paragraph What changed + Code diff. Example copy for Python: ```python
# old
from redwood import tracehook
tracehook.set_trace_context(ctx)
# new
from redwood.trace import TraceContext
TraceContext.attach(ctx)
```
Keep it minimal.

dennis_eng: That's clear. For Node I'm switching from `traceHook.attach()` to the new `tracing.context().set()` pattern. I'll include both snippets with a callout: \"Deprecated — will be removed YYYY-MM-DD\".

lina_sre: For smoke, I only need the PR link. Also check the console dashboard sample that references `trace_id` string length. We had a subtle mismatch in the YAML example that caused the embed to 404 in staging.

maria_docs: Noted. I'll search for the YAML sample `dashboard/samples/trace-to-dashboard.yaml` and update the `trace_id` example to be 32 hex chars.

alex_m: Linkcheck result: `docs/console/tracehook-guide.md` and `docs/console/sdk-snippets.md` reference `#/examples/tracehook-v1` anchor. I'll push a tiny PR to replace anchors to `#/examples/tracehook-v2` and add redirects in the site config. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123

dennis_eng: Opened Node PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4125 — includes shim and tests.

maria_docs: Great. I opened the Python PR for the new snippet and migration note: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4126 — please review.

lina_sre: Reviewed PR #4125 and did a quick perf run. Results look good: no regression in p95 latency, KV cache behavior unchanged. Left one nit about a log message.

alex_m: I applied the anchor redirect in site config PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4128 — added a redirect map and a small test in CI.

maria_docs: Thanks everyone. Final checklist before merge: - [ ] PRs for Python/Node/Rust in draft - [ ] link redirects in site config - [ ] docs-bot sitemap update - [ ] staging smoke test passed

docs-bot: sitemap updated for docs PRs: 4123, 4125, 4126, 4128. Preview builds available at https://deploy-preview-4123--docs.redwood.ai

maria_docs: I'll wait for Lina's final sign-off on staging then we'll remove the v1 snippets after 2 weeks. If anyone wants to keep them longer, speak up now. :eyes:

dennis_eng: fine with 2 weeks. I'll add deprecation date in the PR description.

alex_m: linkcheck green after redirects merged. I'll schedule a quick followup thread to remove v1s on 2-week date.

maria_docs: Awesome — closing coordination. :shipit:
